KUNINGRIIGID GODOT AUTOPORT — 0.75 SOLDIER VISIBILITY HOTFIX RELEASE
Reason: Users see no legible soldiers in the 0.74 Windows application. Release the tested view correction with 90m tactical camera, non-wrapping command bars, full-resolution Windows battles, larger high-contrast atlas army visuals, town rally positions outside the opaque main hall, and safe fallback when a soldier GLB resource is unavailable.
Fix: PR #27 merged as 385e10704e756b6235904dd8426e447033058e31.
Rendered checks: actual Godot 4.4.1 Mesa offscreen screenshots and nonzero screen-pixel differences for 96-fighter tactical battle, world atlas, and city detail plus 3 original V148 and 3 V262 TRELLIS meshes, raw and rigged, succeeded in GitHub Actions 41923422749.
Release gate: build-apps workflow must load both exported Android Content.pck and Windows Content.pck in an empty project and check that axeman/spearman/slinger GLBs are loadable and skinned with Skeleton3D. Do not publish if the exported PCK is missing those resources.
